dialog.content: Rikuno, what you said is exactly it!
The murder weapon was exactly a kitchen knife, lodged in the victim's chest!

With none other than a kitchen knife sticking out of the victim's body.
We can ascertain that the victim died of blood loss. Because they got stabbed.
